Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

At the grocery store, an African American woman and a Middle Eastern woman were finishing their shopping and each had a whole cart full of food for the week, as they each had a pretty big family. Once they got to checkout, the African American woman got through everything quickly because she just handed the cashier cash, but it took awhile longer for the Middle Eastern woman, since the cashier had to remove several items that couldn't be purchased using her benefits card. Who is on food stamps?
A. The African American woman
B. The Middle Eastern woman
C. Can't answer
